claims.claim: File a written response with the court.
claims.quote: A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
claims.note: The required response is a written pleading.

claims.claim: File specifically with the court clerk.
claims.quote: file with the court a written pleading
claims.note: The filing direction names the court, not the clerk.

claims.claim: File the response before the deadline.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
claims.note: This is the ordinary summons direction, subject to statutory exceptions.

claims.claim: A general denial is allowed when the complaint in a limited civil case is unverified.
claims.quote: If the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1 or is not verified, a general denial is sufficient but only puts in issue the material allegations of the complaint.
claims.note: This supports the type of denial, not the use of a particular form.

claims.claim: PLD-050 is the short general denial form.
claims.note: The form text was not provided.

claims.claim: PLD-050 may be used in any unverified limited civil case.
claims.note: Section 431.30(d) does not establish the form's eligibility rules. The citation note about assigned claims over $1,000 is not the form text.

claims.claim: The limited civil amount ceiling is $35,000, inclusive.
claims.quote: (a) The amount in controversy does not exceed thirty-five thousand dollars ($35,000).
claims.note: The statutory amount in controversy excludes attorneys’ fees, interest, and costs.

claims.claim: A claim of $35,000 or less is a limited civil case by virtue of its amount.
claims.quote: an action or special proceeding shall be treated as a limited civil case only if all of the following conditions are satisfied:
claims.note: Amount is necessary but not sufficient. Subdivisions (b) and (c) also restrict the relief sought.

claims.claim: A person who cannot afford the filing fee can request a fee waiver.
claims.note: No fee-waiver criteria or request instructions were supplied.

claims.claim: FW-001 is the form for that request.
claims.note: The form text was not provided.

flags.text: “Any” extends the statute's general-denial rule to a specific form whose restrictions have not been checked.
Reliance on PLD-050 where it is not allowed could leave the response defective and risk default.
The amount ceiling is presented as a complete definition of a limited civil case.
Neither named form was supplied, and the filing statute does not specify filing with the clerk.
“File” and “If you cannot afford the filing fee, ask” direct the reader to take procedural steps.

result.summary: The statutes support timely filing of a written pleading and a general denial for an unverified complaint. They do not establish when PLD-050 may be used or verify the FW-001 instruction. The $35,000 ceiling is only one condition for limited civil classification.
